newsitem.title: UK: Portugal's EDP buys up to 75,000 tonnes HS fuel.
newsitem.headline: Portugal's EDP buys up to 75,000 tonnes HS fuel.

text.p: Portugal's state electricty company Electricidade de Portugal EdP bought up to 75,000 tonnes of high sulphur fuel oil by tender on Wednesday, company officials and trade sources said.
German trading firm Stinnes will supply one cargo while U.S. refiner and trading company Koch won the bid to supply two others, traders said. Delivery dates are April 21-25, April 26-30 and May 4-8.
The price was heard to be around $8 above the average of the north European and Mediterranean fob quotations.
